blocks.text: Insanon mein intermediate pituitary anterior aur posterior pituitary ke darmiyan cells ki ek patli teh hai. Yeh melanocyte stimulating hormone (MSH) banata hai. MSH jild aur baalon ke melanocytes (rang banane wale cells) se melanin banwata aur chhurwata hai.

items: Barhte hue bachche mein growth hormone (GH) zyada nikle to gigantism hota hai: qad ausat se bohat zyada, aur haath, paon aur chehre ke naqoosh bare. Balighon mein GH zyada nikle to acromegaly hota hai: haddiyan lambi to nahin ho saktin magar moti hoti jati hain; haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra bare ho jate hain.

GH ki kami se dwarfism (baunapan) hota hai: nashonuma bohat aahista hoti hai aur qad chhota rehta hai. Lekin jism ke hisse aapas mein mutanasib (proportion mein) rehte hain aur dimagh ki nashonuma aur IQ par asar nahin hota.
TSH zyada ho to hyperthyroidism (thyroxine zyada) aur kam ho to hypothyroidism (thyroxine ki kami) hota hai.
ADH kam ho to diabetes insipidus hota hai: bohat zyada patla peshab aur baar baar pyaas. ADH zyada ho to gurdon ke masail ho sakte hain.
Oxytocin zyada ho to uterus ki deewar phat sakti hai, aur kam ho to normal labour (zachgi ka amal) ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Pituitary ko master gland kyun kehte hain, aur yeh poori kahani kyun nahin?
blocks.explanation: Anterior pituitary ke hormones (ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH) doosre endocrine glands (adrenal cortex, thyroid, ovaries, testes) ko chalate hain, is liye ise master gland kehte hain. Magar pituitary khud hypothalamus ke qaboo mein hai: hypothalamus releasing aur inhibiting hormones bhejta hai aur posterior pituitary ke hormones (oxytocin, ADH) bhi khud banata hai.

items: Teen lobes: anterior (GH, ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH, prolactin), posterior (ADH aur oxytocin sirf jama kar ke chhorta hai), intermediate (MSH).
GH zyada: bachpan mein gigantism, balighon mein acromegaly; GH kam: dwarfism.
TSH zyada/kam: hyperthyroidism/hypothyroidism; ADH kam: diabetes insipidus; oxytocin zyada: uterus ki deewar phatna, kam: labour mein rukawat.
